detail.longDescription: GHManage 0.9.3 is out, my keyboard-driven Windows and Mac app for working with GitHub. - Enter on an Activity event opens the issue, pull request, release or commit right in GHManage, and Backspace brings you back. - F1 in the search dialog lists GitHub's search terms with examples, ready to insert. - A Go To menu jumps to any view of a repository, and Copy now offers clone URLs. Installed copies update on their own. https:// github.com/TheIdeaPlace/GHMana ge/releases/tag/v0.9.3 # GHManage # GitHub # Accessibility # ScreenReader
